profile.headline: C2 Systems, C2 Level Autonomy, Team and Technical Leadership, Strategy and Software Architecture
profile.summary: Technical leader, developer and architect with over two decades of experience aligning software innovation with strategic objectives across aerospace, defense, and startup domains. Adept at driving R&D and operational excellence in real-time systems, vehicle management and C2 level autonomy. Combined deep technical expertise with entrepreneurial vision and a track record of leading distributed teams to deliver high-impact, mission-aligned solutions.
